title: ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Department of Animal Services’ (DAS) staffing and deployment of Animal Control Officers,…
text:
[Council File 26-1411]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Department of Animal Services’ (DAS) staffing and deployment of Animal Control Officers, and resources needed to maintain the level of services and response time to ensure the safety of animals and residents across the City.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Rodriguez – Jurado):
DIRECT the DAS to report to Council on its current staffing and deployment of Animal Control Officers, and what is needed to maintain the level of services that achieve the response time that ensures safety for the animals and residents across the City.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion on the Department of Animal Services' current Animal Control Officer staffing and deployment, and the resources needed to keep service and response times at their current level.
